groups.why_chosen: Checkpointing trades periodic save overhead (O_save) for bounded recovery: when a fault strikes before a checkpoint completes, only the progress since the last complete checkpoint (O_lost) is lost, and recovery reloads exactly that last complete checkpoint (O_restart).
groups.what_to_learn: a Gantt-style iteration timeline with periodic checkpoint boxes, a dashed box for a lost/incomplete one, and bracketed spans quantifying save/lost/restart overhead
